projects.title: Optimize Grok 2
projects.objective: Reduce Grok 2 time to first token and increase decode throughput on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell without regressing output quality.

orchestrator.name: Orchestrator
orchestrator.task: Coordinate TTFT and throughput tracks, challenge every claimed gain, and promote only reproducible results.
orchestrator.finding: The workload is memory-bandwidth bound at decode, so the program is concentrating on tokens verified per weight read and prefill efficiency rather than launch-overhead optimizations.
orchestrator.current_work: Reconciling the speculative-decoding headline with the latency track and the final quality screen.

reconciler.name: Final reconciler
reconciler.task: Assemble the minimal production patch from validated team branches and retain reproducibility evidence.
reconciler.finding: The promoted set is additive: corrected flash attention, larger micro-batches, unified KV at concurrency, and n-gram speculation for high-overlap code workloads.
reconciler.current_work: Running the final branch matrix against baseline outputs and the committed benchmark harness.

teams.name: Speculative decoding
teams.thesis: Increase accepted tokens per 42.4 GiB weight read without changing target-model output.

orchestrator.name: Speculation
orchestrator.task: Coordinate drafting strategy, acceptance analysis, and workload-specific validation.
orchestrator.finding: Verifying nine tokens costs 36.40 ms versus 36.00 ms for one token, making narrow speculative chains unusually efficient on Grok 2.
orchestrator.current_work: Validating the 3× code-edit result across fresh prompts and clean server restarts.

agents.name: N-gram drafter
agents.task: Benchmark llama.cpp n-gram drafting variants against realistic code-edit workloads.
agents.finding: `ngram-map-k4v` raises whole-file code editing from 28.48 to 85.70 tok/s at 87% acceptance with byte-identical output.
agents.current_work: Repeating the byte-level equivalence suite on mechanical renames and long edits.

agents.name: Workload analyst
agents.task: Bound where prompt lookup helps and where it correctly falls back to baseline behavior.
agents.finding: The gain tracks input/output overlap: code edits improve 201%, while JSON extraction, summarization, and open-ended generation remain at baseline.
agents.current_work: Expanding the negative-control set so the scope of the headline remains explicit.

teams.name: Attention & prefill
teams.thesis: Remove Grok-specific attention path defects and improve prompt processing without quality shortcuts.

orchestrator.name: Attention
orchestrator.task: Coordinate flash-attention correctness, micro-batch sizing, and TTFT measurement.
orchestrator.finding: Grok's flash-attention guard masks a scale and softcap routing bug; correcting the parameters unlocks a 19.9% prefill gain with coherent output.
orchestrator.current_work: Correlating prompt-length TTFT with corrected attention and `-ub 2048`.

agents.name: Flash attention
agents.task: Fix Grok attention scaling and logit softcapping in llama.cpp's fused path.
agents.finding: Passing Grok's 1/sqrt(128) scale and 30.0 softcap to the fused kernel produces coherent output and moves prefill from 964.38 to 1155.96 tok/s.
agents.current_work: Running task-level accuracy screening on the corrected fused implementation.

agents.name: TTFT profiler
agents.task: Measure uncached time to first token across prompt lengths and isolate prefill bottlenecks.
agents.finding: Disabling prompt caching exposed the real 775 ms–11.81 s latency curve; `-ub 2048` improves prefill by 11.2% with bit-exact output.
agents.current_work: Profiling the combined micro-batch and fused-attention path on 497-token interactive prompts.

teams.name: Memory & batching
teams.thesis: Use the 96 GB device efficiently across concurrent streams while preserving interactive latency.

orchestrator.name: Memory
orchestrator.task: Coordinate KV layout, cache precision, concurrency, and Blackwell capacity experiments.
orchestrator.finding: Unified KV grows with batch size and reaches a 17.3% decode gain at 16 streams, but it trades away prefill and must be workload-gated.
orchestrator.current_work: Selecting the serving policy that balances aggregate TPS and per-user TTFT.

agents.name: Unified KV
agents.task: Benchmark shared KV layout from one through sixteen concurrent streams.
agents.finding: `--kv-unified` moves 16-stream decode from 112.86 to 132.40 aggregate tok/s while remaining bit-exact.
agents.current_work: Finding the prompt-to-generation crossover where unified KV becomes a net win.

agents.name: Cache precision
agents.task: Measure quantized K/V cache capacity, speed, and output-quality effects.
agents.finding: Q8 V-cache halves V-cache memory after the flash-attention fix at roughly 1.4% decode cost; K-cache quantization regresses at batch eight.
agents.current_work: Testing whether the freed memory supports more useful concurrent slots than the decode penalty costs.

teams.name: Quality & reproducibility
teams.thesis: Reject attractive numbers that do not survive output equivalence, accuracy, and clean-room reproduction.

orchestrator.name: Quality
orchestrator.task: Own output equivalence, generative accuracy, benchmark methodology, and final promotion gates.
orchestrator.finding: The defensible headline isolates one stream, disables prompt caching, uses stock weights, and verifies output byte-for-byte.
orchestrator.current_work: Reviewing every promoted run for caching, batching, and measurement artifacts.

agents.name: Accuracy evaluator
agents.task: Run generative MMLU, ARC-Easy, and targeted coherence screens.
agents.finding: The committed baseline records 103/150 MMLU and 150/150 ARC-Easy with zero unparsed outputs; promoted variants are compared against that anchor.
agents.current_work: Screening the corrected flash-attention branch across the targeted coherence set.

agents.name: Reproduction engineer
agents.task: Rebuild the environment on a fresh Blackwell pod and reproduce promoted results.
agents.finding: The full setup is reproducible from a persistent volume; model load is 8.5 seconds once the 76.2 GiB artifact is present.
agents.current_work: Executing a clean-server reproduction of the final performance stack.

decisions.title: Promote n-gram speculation
decisions.detail: 3.0× code-edit throughput on stock weights with byte-identical output.

decisions.title: Correct fused attention
decisions.detail: Routes Grok's scale and softcap into the fused kernel before removing the guard.

decisions.title: Gate unified KV by workload
decisions.detail: Wins at high concurrency but costs prefill, so serving policy must consider prompt length.

decisions.title: Reject K-cache quantization
decisions.detail: The apparent batch-one gain becomes a regression at realistic concurrency.

projects.title: Grok 2 Vision
projects.objective: Add production-grade image understanding to Grok 2 through a transparent OpenAI-compatible multimodal service with low latency and grounded outputs.
projects.hardware: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell · Grok 2 + Qwen3-VL sidecar

orchestrator.name: Orchestrator
orchestrator.task: Coordinate visual perception, OpenAI-compatible serving, latency, and grounding into one durable Grok 2 image model.
orchestrator.finding: A sidecar is the viable near-term path because open Grok 2 has no vision tower or mmproj; the service hides that composition behind one model endpoint.
orchestrator.current_work: Reconciling router failover, prompt-cache affinity, and final visual grounding tests.

reconciler.name: Final reconciler
reconciler.task: Assemble the router, sidecar, startup, and integration changes into one reproducible service.
reconciler.finding: The deployment can expose image and text turns through the same OpenAI contract while keeping the vision pipeline invisible to clients.
reconciler.current_work: Running end-to-end streaming and cold-start recovery across both model pods.

teams.name: Visual perception
teams.thesis: Extract complementary scene, object, and text evidence before Grok 2 reasons over the image.

orchestrator.name: Perception
orchestrator.task: Coordinate captioning, object detection, OCR, and evidence composition.
orchestrator.finding: Caption, detection, and OCR passes are complementary; all three can run concurrently and the 270B model should decide relevance.
orchestrator.current_work: Testing hard scenes where one perception pass is empty or misleading.

agents.name: Scene captioning
agents.task: Serve Qwen3-VL-4B as the high-recall scene description sidecar.
agents.finding: Moving the Qwen3-VL sidecar to GPU reduces description latency from 12.29 seconds to 1.12 seconds and corrects shape grounding.
agents.current_work: Measuring caption stability across follow-up questions and repeated images.

agents.name: OCR & detection
agents.task: Combine low-latency OCR and object detection with the scene narrative.
agents.finding: YOLOE detection measures 10.1 ms and OCR 27.9 ms, making both effectively free beside the caption and Grok 2 generation stages.
agents.current_work: Validating text-heavy images without injecting harmful bounding-box detail.

teams.name: Multimodal serving
teams.thesis: Present Grok 2 Vision as one standard model rather than a frontend-managed pipeline.

orchestrator.name: Serving
orchestrator.task: Own the OpenAI schema, streaming semantics, health behavior, and stable routing layer.
orchestrator.finding: The image router accepts ordinary image_url content blocks and streams ordinary chat completions, so clients require no vision-specific orchestration.
orchestrator.current_work: Hardening partial-upstream failure and stream cancellation behavior.

agents.name: Streaming protocol
agents.task: Pass server-sent completion events through the vision service without buffering.
agents.finding: Chunked transfer plus `X-Accel-Buffering: no` delivers the first Grok 2 token in 1.14 seconds through the RunPod proxy.
agents.current_work: Testing cancellation and malformed upstream chunks under load.

agents.name: Stable router
agents.task: Route model aliases across rotating pods with retry, cooldown, and health visibility.
agents.finding: One stable hostname now selects Grok 2, Grok 2 Fast, or Grok 2 Image by model id and retries around unhealthy pods.
agents.current_work: Validating prompt-cache affinity while retaining failover.

teams.name: Latency & capacity
teams.thesis: Fit the perception sidecar beside the 76.2 GiB model and keep cold starts observable.

orchestrator.name: Capacity
orchestrator.task: Coordinate GPU placement, warm startup, slot capacity, and fail-fast health behavior.
orchestrator.finding: The combined services occupy 86,580 MiB on the 96 GB card, leaving enough headroom for the working multimodal path.
orchestrator.current_work: Stress-testing sanitized per-GPU slot reporting under concurrent image turns.

agents.name: Warm startup
agents.task: Preload perception engines and expose loading failures before traffic arrives.
agents.finding: Preloading removes an 8.6-second first-request penalty and turns silent OCR initialization loss into an explicit boot failure.
agents.current_work: Verifying restart recovery from the persistent workspace on every pod.

agents.name: GPU placement
agents.task: Balance Grok 2, captioning, OCR, and detection across GPU and CPU resources.
agents.finding: GPU captioning dominates the latency win; detection and OCR can remain CPU-bound to avoid CUDA contention at only ~38 ms combined.
agents.current_work: Profiling concurrent requests for memory pressure and sidecar starvation.

teams.name: Grounding & evaluation
teams.thesis: Make Grok 2 answer from visual evidence without exposing plumbing or inventing unavailable detail.

orchestrator.name: Grounding
orchestrator.task: Own multimodal prompt construction, follow-up behavior, POPE, and TextVQA evaluation.
orchestrator.finding: Evidence should be framed as Grok 2's own observations; tool-oriented preambles leak implementation detail and degrade answers.
orchestrator.current_work: Expanding grounded follow-up conversations and OCR-heavy evaluation cases.

agents.name: Evidence prompting
agents.task: Compose visual evidence into Grok 2 prompts without leaking tool names or stale questions.
agents.finding: Using only the latest user question and carrying prior turns as conversation fixes follow-up contamination; always including the caption fixes missing-scene answers.
agents.current_work: Testing adversarial follow-ups and conflicting perception evidence.

agents.name: Vision evaluator
agents.task: Measure object, scene, and text understanding against sidecar architecture bounds.
agents.finding: Prior sidecar evidence reaches 84.79 POPE—99.4% of a native tower—while text-heavy understanding remains the adaptation target.
agents.current_work: Running the Grok 2-specific object and TextVQA evaluation slice.

decisions.title: Ship one multimodal model endpoint
decisions.detail: The client sends standard image_url content and never manages the perception pipeline.

decisions.title: Move captioning to GPU
decisions.detail: Qwen3-VL corrects shape grounding while cutting the dominant perception stage by more than 10×.

decisions.title: Run perception passes concurrently
decisions.detail: Caption, OCR, and detection provide complementary evidence; keyword gating hid necessary context.

decisions.title: Evaluate decoder adaptation
decisions.detail: Text-heavy images remain bounded by Grok 2's use of injected evidence and need a targeted training path.
